description: This file defines the ValidationUniqueDao class, which provides a method to check the uniqueness of a value within a certain entity in the database. It extends a base DAO class and constructs a query to determine if a specific value is unique with optional filters for entity ID and match criteria.

classes.name: ValidationUniqueDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for validating the uniqueness of values within entities in the database.

methods.name: isValueUnique
methods.description: Checks whether a given value is unique within a specified entity, with optional filters for entity ID and matching field/value.
